text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly implements national-scale (Turkey) spatial land system modeling with future projections to 2050. Its primary objective is to simulate and compare alternative land system trajectories under a Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) scenario versus a business-as-usual scenario—thus involving ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison. The study uses the CLUMondo model to produce spatially explicit, mapped land system (a form of LULC) projections at 2×2 km resolution. Outputs include quantified changes in land systems, degradation/improvement areas, and scenario comparisons with metrics such as area extents, conversion causes, and regional breakdowns. All core inclusion criteria are met: national-scale coverage, primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation, multi-scenario quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with explicit outputs, and mapped projections. None of the exclusion criteria apply—it is not global, local, species-focused, economic-only, carbon-only, methodological without application, qualitative, remote sensing technical, or single-scenario.)
